family.description: SmAKAP is a small membrane-bound PKA-RI-specific protein kinase A-anchoring protein, referred to as small membrane-AKAP. It is probably tethered to the plasma membrane most through a dual acylation of its N-terminal Met-Gly-Cys- motif (myristoylation and palmitoylation, respectively). It specifically targets PKA-RI isoforms to the plasma membrane. It localizes to plasma membranes, is enriched at cell-cell junctions and associates with filopodia [[cite:PUB00067440]].
family.name: Small membrane A-kinase anchor protein
